summary: Extended schema-v1 staged operations with typed preimage-preserving move/delete recovery and a fenced, fsynced, atomic line append primitive, with comprehensive failure-injection coverage and documentation.
behavior_implemented: Added typed StagedMove, StagedDelete, and IntentTargetKind APIs while preserving existing replacement signatures, behavior, and five-field schema-version-1 intent bytes.

Added ordered atomic move and delete application with retained preimages, same-volume and path-collision enforcement, bounded PermissionError retries, per-attempt path/hash validation, and nonce fencing.
Extended inspection, successor completion, reverse rollback, resumable inverse operations, and audit finalizers across replace, move, delete, and mixed intents.

Added atomic_append_line_bytes with complete-line validation, safe parent creation, valid-active-intent support, malformed-intent rejection, copy-on-write fsync and replacement, per-retry drift/path/fence checks, and hard-link-safe semantics.
Documented the extended intent vocabulary, recovery state machine, append sequencing, runtime layout, performance consequence, and cooperative-writer race boundary.

Added 68 focused tests covering per-kind and mixed failure recovery, inverse retries, finalizer conflicts, takeover fencing, path substitution, malformed state, successor flows, torn append staging, fsync, and hard links without modifying pre-existing tests.

tests.result: Success: no issues found in 58 source files

tests.command: uv run python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; root = Path('.'); schema = json.loads((root / '.agents/plan/initial/agent-report.schema.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); report = json.loads((root / '.agents/work-orders/WP-201-staging-extensions/report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(report)"

assumptions: The lead-owned 0f99073 activation commit is the intended WP-201 baseline despite the PENDING-WP201-BASELINE contract placeholder.
Local NTFS behavior is exercised directly; POSIX directory fsync remains best effort and SMB/NFS receive no stronger Phase 1 guarantee.

Cooperating writers obey the exclusive context lock; no portable atomic no-clobber guarantee is claimed against a process that creates a move destination inside the final check-to-replace race window.
decisions: Keep intent schema version 1, interpret an absent kind as replace, emit pure replacements in the exact legacy five-field shape, and use strict extended shapes only for move/delete.

Use copy-on-write atomic line append to comply with ADR 0006 canonical-write rules, prevent torn canonical lines, and avoid mutating out-of-bound hard-linked inodes; accept linear ledger-size cost under ADR 0010 Phase 1.
Reject all plain-path collisions across replace targets, delete targets, and both move endpoints after NFC normalization and case folding.
Reject symlink or junction parent chains for move, delete, and append, and revalidate endpoints on every retry before the final nonce fence.
Validate but do not reject a structurally valid active intent during append, allowing both original and successor holders while malformed or unsafe intent state fails closed.
deviations: The contract base remains PENDING-WP201-BASELINE; the operator-pinned integrated base used by the worker is 0f99073e926bcbe5b8405895bac0bc3a80edc409.
The assigned worktree and branch were absent at session start and were created from the pinned base before any edit.
The required WP-300 blocker report is absent from the pinned tree and was read without mutation from agent/WP-300-transaction-engine at its reported worker revision.
No objective, architecture, dependency, public replacement behavior, or allowed-path deviation was made.
security_considerations: New endpoints fail closed on traversal, absolute and wrong-zone paths, nested contexts, symlink/junction parents, retry-time link substitution, malformed intents, and target/source drift.
Nonce fencing is last before every move, delete, restore, and append commit attempt, and delete absence is accepted only after fencing the current holder.
Preimages remain in fsynced transaction backups until verified finalization; invalid parent state cannot discard rollback assets.
Copy-on-write append prevents a context hard link from mutating an inode reachable outside the context boundary.
Fixtures are fictional and no secrets, private data, network services, SQLite paths, or external writes were introduced.
migration_considerations: The intent extension remains schema version 1 and legacy replacement records round-trip byte-for-byte, so no canonical data migration is required.
No domain model, public schema, CLI, SQLite projection, audit-event format, dependency, or runtime backup ownership changed.
unresolved: The lead should replace or explicitly accept the PENDING-WP201-BASELINE administrative placeholder during integration; there is no implementation blocker.
Atomic no-clobber against a non-cooperating process inside the final absence-check race remains outside the documented ADR 0006 Phase 1 guarantee.
recommended_next_action: Lead review abbbb0c007f553f88ce6afa72f378ffb2fc04a7c and the report commit, rerun the full gate independently, integrate WP-201, and resume WP-300 against the new filesystem APIs.
